dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Uh, hi there! May all praise the Moon Maiden!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you an adherent of the "Frostmoon Scions"?

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Umm... Well, since Miss Lyylikki is one of the Scions, I suppose I can be considered one of their adherents... So yeah, that's right! I'm a follower of the Frostmoon Scions!

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Thank you. Please don't interrupt my reverence of Miss Lyy— I mean, of the Moon Maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? Everything adds up perfectly! I recall reading a book somewhere about ancient lunar deities— apparently, the three Moon Goddesses were all once ravishing young maidens.

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: The Goddesses must have taken on such gentle and affable human appearances out of consideration for mere mortals like me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: So, obviously, since the Goddesses have blessed Miss Lyylikki with a similarly gentle and lovely appearance, isn't being devoted to her not tantamount to showing them devotion as well?

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Hehe, ain't that the truth. Miss Lyylikki once told me there's more than one way to court divinity, you know. Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Kantor
dialogues.text: Well! Everyone has their own ways of expressing their faith. Please understand.
